colorTapSetupHint: Follow the hint and tap the matching color.
phoneBalanceHomeDescription: Hold the phone upright and keep it steady
phoneBalanceSetupHint: Hold the phone upright as you normally view it. Stay still for 2 seconds to calibrate, then keep it steady for 10 seconds.
phoneBalanceCalibratingHint: Keep this position and do not move the phone.
phoneBalanceErrorUnsupported: This device or browser does not support motion sensing. Use a supported phone or a real Capacitor device.
phoneBalanceErrorPermission: Motion and orientation permission was denied. Enable it in system or browser settings and try again.
phoneBalanceErrorUnavailable: The motion sensor could not start. Use HTTPS or a real Capacitor device and try again.
phoneBalanceErrorNoSamples: No sensor data was received. Check that the phone supports orientation sensing and keep the page in the foreground.
phoneBalanceInterrupted: The game stopped after going to the background. Please calibrate again.
readArticleErrorUnsupported: This browser does not support speech recognition. Try another browser or a domestic ASR service later.
readArticleErrorPermission: Microphone permission was denied. Enable it in system or browser settings and try again.
readArticleErrorNetwork: Speech recognition is temporarily unavailable (common in some networks). Retry later or use a local/domestic ASR setup.
readArticleErrorUnavailable: Speech recognition could not start. Use HTTPS or a real Capacitor device and try again.
